name: pawtrace
description: PawTrace monorepo：Vite 单页前端 + Express+Prisma+Postgres 后端

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix pawtrace-glass
scripts.stop: pkill -f "node dist/index.js" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "tsx watch src/index.ts" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "vite.*5173" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "vite.*3001" 2>/dev/null || true; npm run db:local:stop
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix pawtrace-glass && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build:web && npm run build:monitor && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js
scripts.build:cloudflare:deploy: npm run build:web && npm run build:monitor && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js --require-api-base
scripts.build:cloudflare:glass: node ./scripts/run-with-env.mjs --default PAWTRACE_API_BASE_URL=https://pawtrace-api.jeremyzhao613.workers.dev --require PAWTRACE_API_BASE_URL -- npm run build --prefix pawtrace-glass
scripts.cloudflare:preview: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev frontend/dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:pages: npm run deploy:cloudflare && npm run deploy:cloudflare:glass
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:full: npm run cloudflare:d1:init && npm run deploy:cloudflare:api && npm run deploy:cloudflare:pages
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare:deploy && wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name pawtrace --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:glass: npm run build:cloudflare:glass && wrangler pages deploy pawtrace-glass/dist --project-name pawtrace-glass --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run build:cloudflare:deploy && wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name pawtrace --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.package:mobile: npm run build:web && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js --target mobile && npm run cap:sync --prefix frontend && node ./scripts/ensure-android-network.mjs
scripts.package:android: npm run build:web && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js --target android && npm run cap:sync:android --prefix frontend && node ./scripts/ensure-android-network.mjs
scripts.package:ios: npm run build:web && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js --target ios && npm run cap:sync:ios --prefix frontend
scripts.package:desktop:prepare: npm run build:web && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs frontend/dist/app/runtime-config.js --target desktop
scripts.local:prepare: node ./scripts/ensure-backend-env.mjs && npm run db:local:start && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.local:dev: npm run local:prepare && npm run dev
